Lava Launches Virat Curve 5G Smartphone in India

Indian smartphone manufacturer Lava has launched its new Virat Curve 5G model. The phone is priced at ₹23,999, with a launch price of ₹19,999, and is available for under ₹25,000. Additionally, Lava announced that its Neo UI will be available on Lava phones in the fourth quarter of 2026.
